request.tone: warm, wondering adventure; violence none, scariness mild, peril moderate
request.note: plan extracted by reading the book; no request exists

pitch.hero: Bree, a sky-dreaming girl stowed away aboard the airship Cirrus
pitch.want: to see the sky-ship and find a place aboard without being caught and put ashore
pitch.obstacle: a crew that sends stowaways to the purser, a storm, and the captain's secret in the sealed hold
pitch.stake: her place aboard, and a frightened sky-whale calf whose thrashing could wreck the ship
pitch.ending_kind: a storm night won by gentleness, honesty or practice, or a kindly setback put ashore

bree.name: Bree
bree.want: to fly in the sky and find a place aboard the Cirrus
bree.voice: close third past; curious, brave, polite, talks to objects and animals

pip.name: Pip
pip.role: thin grey stowaway cat; Bree's companion
pip.voice: mrrp and mews; purrs like a tiny engine when fed

quill.name: Captain Quill
quill.role: captain of the Cirrus; keeper of the secret
quill.want: to deliver Nimbus safely to the haven without anyone learning of him
quill.voice: dry and quick; brisk, guarded, wry

nimbus.name: Nimbus
nimbus.role: sky-whale calf hidden in the sealed hold
nimbus.want: to be calm, free and home among his own kind
nimbus.voice: a low hoooom; flinches at thunder and loud noise

bosun.name: the bosun
bosun.want: to keep the crew working and the ship safe in the storm
bosun.voice: foghorn roar, gruff but kind, calls Bree small fry

cook.name: the cook
cook.want: to feed everyone and stop the sardine thief

rigger.name: the wiry rigger
rigger.role: rigger in charge of the envelope and the rope-bridge
rigger.voice: practical, kind, fond of his LOW AND SLOW sign

first_officer.name: the first officer
first_officer.role: tall officer with rain on her coat
first_officer.want: to get the ship around the storm
first_officer.voice: brisk, impatient, quick to cover the secret

truth.question: What is the Cirrus secretly carrying in her sealed hold, and why is the ship rocking in the storm?
truth.statement: The Cirrus secretly carries Nimbus, a sky-whale calf Captain Quill cut from a hunter's net and is flying east to the haven. He lives in the sealed, warm lower hold, eats forty buckets of fish mash a day, and is kept secret because hunters pay well for sky-whales; the crew think they haul tea. He hates thunder and loud noise, so in the storm his frightened thrashing is what rocks the ship.

bree_dreams_of_sky.text: Bree is a girl who has dreamed about the sky for as long as she can remember.

airship_cirrus.text: The great airship Bree is aboard is called the Cirrus.

cirrus_cast_off.text: The Cirrus has cast off from the mooring tower and is flying.

captain_quill.text: Captain Quill commands the Cirrus and speaks in a dry, quick voice.

bree_stowaway.text: Bree is a stowaway aboard the Cirrus.

bree_has_ticket.text: Bree has a ticket and a cabin aboard the Cirrus.

hid_in_rope_coil.text: Bree hid curled up inside a coil of rope on the boarding deck.

four_ways_deck.text: Four ways lead off the boarding deck: a hatch to the engine room, a ramp to the cargo hold, a ladder to the crow's nest and glass doors to the grand saloon.

sailor_approaching.text: A sailor shouting to coil a line is walking toward Bree's hiding place.

bree_no_ticket.text: Bree has no ticket, no cabin and no name in the purser's book.

purser.text: A thin purser keeps the ship's ledger in an office where stowaways are taken.

stowaways_go_to_purser.text: Stowaways are taken to the purser, whose office has a lock on the door.

bree_put_ashore.text: Bree is caught and set ashore at the next port, leaving the Cirrus.

bree_stays_aboard.text: Bree is given a place among the crew and stays aboard the Cirrus.

stoker_singing.text: A big stoker shovels coal in the engine room and sings to the engine, calling it old girl.

catwalk_or_floor.text: A sturdy catwalk leads the long way round the engine room; the open floor is quicker but runs behind the stoker.

dials_steam_lift_hold.text: A row of brass-labelled dials on the engine-room wall reads STEAM, LIFT and HOLD.

scuffling_in_bunkers.text: Something too small for a sailor and too bold for a mouse scuffles in the coal bunkers.

steam_lift_meaning.text: STEAM shows how hard the boilers push and LIFT shows how well the balloon holds the ship up.

hold_kept_warm.text: The HOLD dial reads WARM, and a chalked note says to keep it warm down there, by order of the captain.

small_mew_ahead.text: A small curious mew, half mew and half chirp, leads Bree along a passage toward the middle of the ship.

paw_prints_soot.text: A line of tiny sooty paw prints leads through the coal bunkers to a loose hatch.

nook_rope_canvas.text: A passage ends in a nook of spare rope and folded canvas near the middle of the ship, behind a crate.

eyes_behind_crate.text: Bright, unafraid eyes look out at Bree from behind a crate in the nook.

stoker_noticed.text: The stoker heard someone in his engine room and began to turn.

stoker_dismissed.text: The stoker put the empty floor down to tricks of the light and went back to shovelling.

ash_bucket_upside_down.text: Bree tried to pass as a ship's child with a bucket, but it was the ash bucket, held upside down.

sad_note_through_wood.text: A long, low, sad note hums up through the ship's timbers, too sad to be an engine.

forty_sacks_feed.text: Forty sacks of feed are aboard, as if the ship were feeding a circus.

silver_crest_crates.text: A stack of crates in the hold is stamped with a crest in silver paint.

barrel_tunnel_fur.text: A low tunnel of barrels curves toward the middle of the ship, with a tuft of grey fur caught on its rim.

crest_sail_fish.text: The crest shows a silver fish-like creature with fins as wide as sails, leaping over three clouds.

crates_haven_feed.text: The crates are stencilled HAVEN and FEED, 40 SACKS, and the feed smells like the sea.

rag_nest_sardine_tin.text: A nest of old rags and a licked-clean sardine tin show that somebody small lives in the hold.

unlashed_crates_lean.text: Behind the loose netting, unlashed crates shift and a wall of cargo leans toward Bree.

cat_rescued_bree.text: A thin grey cat found Bree boxed in and fetched a deckhand to free her.

grey_cat_aboard.text: A thin grey cat lives secretly aboard the Cirrus.

cat_evades_crew.text: The crew have chased the grey cat for six weeks without catching it.

bree_doesnt_know_cat_name.text: Bree does not know the grey cat's name.

ladder_splits.text: The crow's nest ladder splits into a sheltered inner ladder and open outside rungs with a loose safety clip.

lookout_whistling.text: A lookout whistles in the crow's nest above.

spyglass_and_rope_run.text: A spare spyglass and a rope run marked RUN, HOLD TIGHT hang below the crow's nest.

gasbags_hold_ship.text: Inside the balloon's skin hang gasbags that hold the whole ship up on air.

tired_seam_stern.text: One seam of the balloon near the stern looks puckered, dark and tired, like an old mend.

ship_flying_heavy.text: The lookout says the ship is flying heavy in the belly this trip, as if it had a whale aboard.

saloon_passengers.text: Passengers dine in the grand saloon while a steward serves them.

model_ships_case.text: A glass case behind the saloon curtains holds model ships, the biggest a cut-away model of the Cirrus.

stewards_door.text: A plain STEWARDS ONLY door beside the case smells of fresh bread.

lowest_deck_painted_over.text: On the model of the Cirrus the lowest deck's label has been painted over grey, as if it were hidden.

bree_ate_crust.text: Bree ate a crust of bread from the stewards' pantry.

waiter_boot_near.text: Under the saloon tables a waiter's boot nearly comes down on Bree.

odder_thing_aboard.text: The steward says Bree is not the oddest thing aboard this trip but will not say what he means.

cat_named_pip.text: Bree names the thin grey cat Pip.

pip_thin_scraps.text: Pip is very thin and has been living on scraps for a long time.

pip_befriends_bree.text: Pip presses his head into Bree's hand and becomes her friend.

three_ways_nook.text: Three ways lead from the nook: toward the galley, to a door marked CAPTAIN, and up a rope ladder into the inner rigging.

cook_fish_mash.text: The cook makes forty buckets of fish mash a day for cargo, on the captain's orders.

larder_open.text: The galley larder stands open behind the cook, with cheese on the shelf.

pip_fed_sardines.text: Bree fed Pip a tin of sardines from the galley larder.

pip_purrs.text: Pip purrs a rusty, rumbling purr, like a tiny engine, when he is fed and content.

storm_hits.text: A storm hits the Cirrus: the floor lurches and a warning bell clangs.

pip_sneezed.text: Pip sneezed behind the flour sacks and the cook heard it.

pip_in_coat.text: Bree carries Pip tucked inside her coat.

pip_sardine_thief.text: Pip is the sardine thief the cook has blamed on the mate for six weeks.

pip_galley_cat.text: Pip is kept on as the galley cat.

captains_cabin_charts.text: The captain's cabin holds a chart table, and Captain Quill is in the officers' room next door.

he_not_eating_storm.text: Captain Quill says he has not eaten since noon and that if the storm catches them he will kick the ship to pieces.

detour_costs_day.text: Going around the storm will cost the Cirrus a day.

crew_thinks_tea.text: The crew think the Cirrus is hauling tea.

he_hates_loud_noise.text: He hates thunder and any loud noise, so the hold must be kept quiet and sealed.

chart_storm_course.text: The chart shows the ship's course bending wide around a storm.

whale_doodle_home_east.text: A pencil whale is drawn on the chart with the word HOME and an arrow pointing east.

first_officer.text: The first officer is a tall woman with rain on her coat.

seasick_calf.text: The first officer grumbles about losing a day for the sake of one seasick calf.

nimbus_sketch.text: A sketch of a small whale with sail-like fins is labelled NIMBUS.

nimbus_a_cloud.text: The first officer claims a nimbus is a kind of cloud.

inner_rigging_paths.text: The inner rigging offers a solid catwalk and a swaying rope-bridge marked LIVE ROPE, CROSS LOW AND SLOW.

aft_seam_weak.text: The riggers know an old aft seam of the balloon that always goes in a storm.

crossed_rope_bridge.text: Bree crossed the live rope-bridge low and slow in a gust of the storm.

rigger_saw_crossing.text: A rigger watched Bree cross his rope-bridge and whistled well done.

bree_never_crossed_live_rope.text: Bree has never crossed live rope.

ran_bridge_stuck.text: Bree rushed the rope-bridge and was left tangled in the hand ropes until a rigger freed her.

bosun_foghorn.text: The bosun is an enormous man with a voice like a foghorn.

groan_from_deep_hold.text: A long groan rises from the deep hold that does not sound like timber.

loose_control_line.text: A control line has torn loose on the weather deck and lashes like a snake.

bree_belayed_line.text: Bree caught the loose line and belayed it around a cleat.

sealed_door.text: A great door at the bottom of the ship is nailed with a board saying SEALED BY ORDER OF THE CAPTAIN.

door_bolt_loose.text: The storm has shaken the sealed door's bolt loose, leaving a gap wide enough for a thin girl.

groan_rises_with_thunder.text: The low sad note from below rises when the thunder cracks and sinks when it passes.

bree_hauled_rope.text: Bree helped the crew haul the balloon line until it was made fast.

bree_carried_sand.text: Bree carried sand-buckets across the pitching deck for the crew.

bosun_doesnt_know_bree.text: The bosun does not know Bree; she is not one of his hands.

bree_told_bosun.text: Bree told the bosun the truth, that she is a stowaway.

bree_hid_name_from_bosun.text: Bree ducked away from the bosun without telling him who she is.

bosun_keeps_secret.text: The bosun promises not to have heard Bree's confession until the storm is done.

sealed_hold_nobody_goes.text: Nobody goes into the sealed hold, by order of the captain.

bosun_wonders_hold.text: The bosun would give his whistle to know what is in the sealed hold.

something_alive_afraid.text: The groan in the deep hold is the sound of something alive and afraid.

care_panel.text: A brass panel by the sealed door, signed by Captain Quill, orders forty buckets of mash, harness checks and calm: never shout, never bang.

pale_shape_answers.text: Through the glass hatch a pale shape longer than a lifeboat answers Pip's mew with a long low note.

nimbus_sky_whale_calf.text: The sealed hold holds Nimbus, a cloud-grey sky-whale calf with fins like folded sails.

nimbus_rescued_haven.text: Nimbus was cut from a hunter's net and is bound for the haven.

nimbus_captains_secret.text: Nimbus is Captain Quill's secret, and the card by his door says TELL NO ONE.

nimbus_thrash_rocks_ship.text: When thunder cracks Nimbus flinches and thrashes, and his thrashing rolls the whole ship.

nimbus_hoooom.text: Nimbus sings a long low hoooom, and when he is calm the ship steadies.

pip_steadies_nimbus.text: Pip's small mew makes Nimbus hold still.

strap_pins_fin.text: One strap of Nimbus's leather harness is twisted tight around his left fin, pinning it flat.

bree_nimbus_song.text: Bree made up a three-note song going down like steps, and Nimbus hums it back to her.

fin_freed.text: Bree untangled the harness strap from Nimbus's fin, freeing it.

pip_purr_calms_nimbus.text: Pip lies against Nimbus's nose and purrs, and Nimbus goes still and the ship stops rolling.

small_gentle_calms.text: Nimbus steadies when someone small stays close and stays gentle.

bree_tells_captain_whale.text: Bree tells Captain Quill she has been with the whale and knows what helps him.

main_stair_jammed.text: The storm has jammed the main stair door to the bridge.

flooded_passage.text: A short service passage to the bridge is flooding with rainwater through a broken vent.

bree_practised_speech.text: Bree practised her message: the captain's whale is scared of the thunder, and that is what is rocking the ship.

bree_not_passenger.text: Bree tells a mate she is not a passenger and ducks past him.

crew_leveled_hard_way.text: The crew wrestled the ship level the hard way, and it cost them half the night.

bosun_believes_bree.text: The bosun believes Bree about the whale because she was honest with him.

bosun_disbelieves_bree.text: The bosun does not believe Bree's story of a whale in the hold.

captain_learns_bree_saw.text: Captain Quill learns that Bree went through the storm-opened sealed door and saw Nimbus.

ship_losing_height.text: The Cirrus is dropping and losing height in the storm.

speaking_tube.text: A speaking tube runs from the bridge straight down to Nimbus's hold.

envelope_tearing_aft.text: A rigger reports the balloon's envelope is tearing aft.

crew_unaware.text: The crew have no idea what they are fighting.

cargo_door_banging.text: A cargo door bangs in the wind far below.

ten_minutes_needed.text: The captain needs Nimbus still for ten minutes so the ship can climb out of the storm.

humming_steadies_ship.text: Bree hums low and slow down the speaking tube, Nimbus answers and stills, and the ship answers the helm.

cirrus_clears_storm.text: The Cirrus climbs out of the storm into calm air.

nimbus_reaches_haven.text: Nimbus reaches the haven and swims out to join his own kind.

shout_scared_nimbus.text: Bree's shout down the tube came out like thunder and set Nimbus thrashing.

pip_purr_through_tube.text: Pip's purr, held to the speaking tube, rolls down to the hold and Nimbus stops booming.

pip_ships_cat.text: Pip is made ship's cat with a sardine ration for life, and Bree his keeper.

tear_needs_small_climber.text: The tear is behind ribs only somebody small can fit past; a winch below pulls the patch tight.

envelope_patched.text: The tear in the envelope is closed and the ship stops sinking.

bree_rigger_mate.text: Captain Quill signs Bree on as rigger's mate.

ships_boy_at_tear.text: A ship's boy thin enough to reach the tear climbs to it while Bree works the winch.

ship_limps_emergency.text: With the tear unmended the Cirrus limps down to an emergency mooring.

nimbus_wants_out.text: Nimbus is big enough to fly, knows it, and wants out.

cargo_door_torn_open.text: The storm has torn the hold's great cargo door half open onto the sky.

nimbus_wears_harness.text: Nimbus wears a leather harness around his middle whose buckles nobody has reached since the first thunder.

inner_bay_quiet.text: A padded, windowless inner bay lies off the hold, quiet and still.

nimbus_flies_free.text: Freed of his harness, Nimbus opens both fins and flies out into the storm.

why_fly_east.text: Captain Quill says Nimbus is why the Cirrus flies east.

nimbus_leads_ship.text: Nimbus leads the Cirrus through the storm toward the haven.

nimbus_towed_kite.text: With one fin pinned, Nimbus cannot fly and is towed behind the ship on his harness line like a kite.

nimbus_haven_delayed.text: Nimbus's sore fin must rest for a week before he can go on to the haven.

nimbus_in_inner_bay.text: Bree coaxes Nimbus into the padded inner bay, where he rides out the storm calmly.

hunters_pay_for_whales.text: Hunters pay well for a sky-whale and sailors talk in port, so the secret has kept Nimbus alive.

bosun_vouches.text: The bosun vouches for Bree before the crew because she told him the truth.

crew_laughs_bree.text: The crew laugh at Bree's story of a whale and do not move.

captain_tells_crew.text: Captain Quill tells the crew her secret herself, and nobody laughs.

crew_sees_nimbus.text: The crew follow Bree down to the sealed hold and see Nimbus for themselves.

crew_hums_nimbus.text: The crew sit with Nimbus and hum him through the storm.

bree_shipmate.text: The crew hang Bree a hammock and stitch her name on a jersey as a shipmate.

bree_in_ships_log.text: Captain Quill writes Bree's name in the ship's log as crew.

bree_misses_end.text: Bree sleeps in a warm bunk and does not see the end of the storm.

come_back_taller.text: Captain Quill invites Bree to come back when she is taller and to bring the cat.

mash_explained.text: The cook learns the forty buckets of mash a day were for Nimbus.

n_open.event: Bree, a sky-dreaming girl, has stowed away in a rope coil aboard the airship Cirrus as Captain Quill orders it cast off.

n_start.event: Bree peeks out and sees four ways off the boarding deck while a sailor walks her way.

a_eng1.event: In the roaring engine room a stoker sings to the engine; a sturdy catwalk goes the long way, the open floor runs behind him.

a_eng_deep.event: Among the pipes Bree finds dials labelled STEAM, LIFT and HOLD and hears something small scuffling in the coal bunkers.

a_eng_a.event: Bree reads the dials; the HOLD dial reads WARM with a captain's order to keep it warm, and a low hatch breathes warm air.

a_eng_a2.event: In a snug lamp-lit passage a curious mew answers Bree's hello and she follows it.

a_eng_b.event: In the coal bunkers Bree finds tiny paw prints leading to a loose hatch and hears a half-mew, half-chirp.

a_eng_b2.event: The sooty paw prints lead along a warm service passage toward the mew, fading at the lamplight's edge.

a_eng_conv.event: The passage ends in a nook of rope and canvas; bright, unafraid eyes blink from behind a SAILCLOTH crate.

a_eng_risk.event: Halfway across the floor the stoker hears her and turns; she can hide behind the coal chute or grab a bucket and look busy.

a_eng_recover.event: Hidden behind the chute, Bree waits until the stoker blames tricks of the light, then slips into the pipe maze.

e_set_eng.event: Caught with the ash bucket upside down, Bree waits in the purser's office as cargo and hears a sad low note through the bench.

b_hold1.event: In the lantern-lit cargo hold a deckhand grumbles about forty sacks of feed; a tidy aisle and a loose net lie ahead.

b_hold_deep.event: Deep in the hold Bree sees silver-crested crates and a barrel tunnel with grey fur on its rim.

b_hold_a.event: The crest shows a sail-finned fish over clouds, stencilled HAVEN and FEED, 40 SACKS; the feed smells of the sea.

b_hold_a2.event: On a walkway a small shape crosses, makes a half-mew, half-chirp and slips behind a crate, wanting her to follow.

b_hold_b.event: In the barrel tunnel Bree finds a rag nest and a licked-clean sardine tin: somebody small lives here.

b_hold_b2.event: A half-mew, half-chirp leads Bree on toward the middle of the ship, past a second sardine tin.

b_hold_conv.event: In a nook of rope and canvas, two bright eyes open behind a crate and blink hello.

b_hold_risk.event: Past the netting, unlashed crates shift and a wall of cargo leans over Bree; she can scramble clear or squeeze into a gap.

b_hold_recover.event: Bree scrambles clear as the crates settle, steadies a box and takes the safer aisle deeper in.

e_set_hold.event: Boxed in, Bree is found by a thin grey cat who fetches a deckhand; she is put ashore without knowing the cat's name.

c_nest1.event: The crow's nest ladder splits into a sheltered inner ladder and open outside rungs with a loose safety clip; someone whistles above.

c_nest_deep.event: Under the lookout's boots Bree finds a spare spyglass and a rope run marked RUN, HOLD TIGHT.

c_nest_a.event: Through the spyglass Bree learns how the gasbags hold the ship up and spots one tired seam near the stern.

c_nest_a2.event: In a sheltered gangway a questioning half-mew, half-chirp draws Bree down toward the middle of the ship.

c_nest_b.event: Bree slides down the rope run out of the wind as the lookout calls after her, and finds a warm passage.

c_nest_b2.event: A hopeful mew guides Bree along a lamp-lit passage toward the middle of the ship.

c_nest_conv.event: In a nook of coiled rope and folded sail, two patient eyes look out from behind a crate.

c_nest_risk.event: On the open rungs a gust shakes the mast; the safety clip swings past and the rail is ten rungs up as the next gust comes.

c_nest_recover.event: Bree clips on just in time, rides out the gust, and climbs back to take the sheltered inner ladder.

e_set_nest.event: The lookout hauls Bree into the crow's nest, keeps her warm to port and jokes that the ship flies heavy, as if with a whale aboard.

d_salon1.event: In the glowing grand saloon a steward serves supper; shadowy curtains and long tablecloths offer two ways through.

d_salon_deep.event: Behind the curtains is a service room with a case of model ships, the biggest the Cirrus, and a STEWARDS ONLY door.

d_salon_a.event: The cut-away model of the Cirrus has every deck labelled except the lowest, which is painted over grey.

d_salon_a2.event: In a plain warm hallway a half-mew, half-chirp from the middle of the ship draws Bree on.

d_salon_b.event: In the pantry Bree eats a crust of bread while the steward assures a lady there is no mouse aboard.

d_salon_b2.event: A mew that smells bread leads Bree along a warm corridor toward the middle of the ship.

d_salon_conv.event: In a quiet nook of rope and sailcloth, two hopeful eyes shine from behind a crate.

d_salon_risk.event: Under the tables a waiter's boot nearly lands on Bree; a trolley's shadow is close, the door six steps away.

d_salon_recover.event: Bree rolls behind the trolley, waits out the waiter, then slips behind the curtains into a room.

e_set_salon.event: The steward catches Bree, feeds her in the purser's office and hints she is not the oddest thing aboard before putting her ashore.

n_friend.event: A thin grey cat steps out, befriends Bree and is named Pip; three ways lead on: galley, captain's cabin, rigging.

f_galley1.event: The cook grumbles about forty buckets of fish mash for cargo; the larder is open behind him and flour sacks offer cover.

f_galley_a.event: Bree opens sardines for Pip; he eats them all and purrs for the first time, then the floor lurches.

f_galley_b.event: Behind the flour sacks Pip sneezes; the cook hears it and turns as Bree weighs running against holding still.

f_galley_mid.event: In the tipping corridor a warning bell clangs; Bree tucks Pip into her coat and runs toward the noise.

e_set_galley.event: The cook unmasks Pip as his sardine thief, feeds them, keeps Pip as galley cat and sends Bree ashore puzzling over forty buckets.

f_cabin1.event: The captain's cabin is empty, charts on the table; Captain Quill's voice sounds displeased from the officers' room next door.

f_cabin_a.event: Bree hears the captain say he has not eaten, hates thunder and loud noise, and the crew think they haul tea; a bell rings.

f_cabin_b.event: The chart shows the course bending around a storm and a pencil whale marked HOME, east; boots come and Bree must hide.

f_cabin_b2.event: From the curtain Bree sees the first officer grab the storm chart, grumbling about a seasick calf, then run as a bell clangs.

f_cabin_mid.event: The corridor pitches and the bell clangs; Bree tucks Pip into her coat and runs after the crew.

e_set_cabin.event: The first officer finds Bree and Pip under the table; Bree sees a whale sketch marked NIMBUS and is told it is a cloud.

f_rig1.event: In the inner rigging Pip waits on a rope-bridge marked LIVE ROPE, CROSS LOW AND SLOW beside a solid catwalk.

f_rig_a.event: From the catwalk Bree hears riggers shout about the old aft seam that always goes; the storm's first gust hits.

f_rig_b.event: Halfway across the bridge a gust kicks it sideways; six planks remain and a bigger gust is coming.

f_rig_b2.event: Bree crosses low and slow through the gust and reaches the platform; a watching rigger whistles well done.

f_rig_mid.event: The storm shakes the rigging and the bell clangs; Bree tucks Pip into her coat and climbs down toward the shouting.

e_set_rig.event: Rushing, Bree is tangled in the bridge ropes; a rigger frees her, keeps her clipped to him and mutters about an old seam.

n_storm.event: The storm tosses the Cirrus; the bosun calls all hands, and a groan from the deep hold turns Pip's ears.

s_deck1.event: On the weather deck a loose control line lashes and an officer calls for help as Bree's boots slide.

s_deck_a.event: Bree belays the line; the officer asks whose girl she is and sends her below to learn what is groaning in the deep hold.

s_deck_b.event: A sliding crate bears down on Bree's post; a hatch is two steps away, the wheelhouse far across the deck.

s_deck_mid.event: Following the groan down to the bottom of the ship, Bree finds a door SEALED BY ORDER OF THE CAPTAIN, its bolt shaken loose.

e_set_storm1.event: A rigger shuts Bree and Pip in a safe cabin; all night a sad note rises with the thunder and nobody tells her what it was.

s_crew1.event: The crew haul a balloon line and the bosun begs for one more pair of hands and for sand on the deck.

s_crew_a.event: Bree throws her weight on the rope until it is made fast; the crew cheer and thump her back.

s_crew_b.event: Bree carries two heavy sand-buckets across the pitching deck as one starts to tip.

s_crew_mid.event: The bosun sees Bree for the first time, knows she is not one of his hands and asks who she is.

s_crew_truth.event: Bree confesses she is a stowaway; the bosun laughs, keeps her secret, and sends her to look in the sealed hold.

s_crew_dodge.event: Bree escapes down the ladder with her name kept, follows the groan to a sealed door with its bolt shaken loose.

e_set_storm2.event: Knocked down by the buckets, Bree is benched by the bosun, who would give his whistle to know what is in the sealed hold.

s_hold1.event: At the sealed door the groan sounds alive and afraid; a glass hatch and a brass panel of writing invite a look.

s_hold_a.event: Through the glass a huge pale shaking shape answers Pip's mew with a long low note.

s_hold_b.event: The brass panel, signed by Captain Quill, gives feeding, harness and calming orders: this is somebody's bedroom.

s_hold_mid.event: Thunder jolts a bolt free and the sealed door swings open; Pip and Bree go in.

n_secret.event: Inside is Nimbus, the captain's secret sky-whale calf; thunder makes him thrash and rock the ship until Pip's mew stills him.

p_save1.event: Up close, Bree sees a harness strap twisted tight around Nimbus's left fin, making him jerk and rock the ship.

p_save_a.event: Bree hums three falling notes and Nimbus hums them back; the strap is still twisted but he stops fighting it.

p_save_b.event: Bree works the strap free; the fin unfolds and Nimbus breathes a grateful hoooom and lays it beside her.

p_pip1.event: Well-fed Pip curls against Nimbus's nose and purrs; Nimbus stills and the ship stops rolling.

p_save_mid.event: Knowing Nimbus steadies when someone small stays gentle, Bree climbs to the wheelhouse and tells the captain she has been with her whale.

p_reveal1.event: The main stair to the bridge is jammed; a long dry stair or a short flooding passage remain.

p_reveal_a.event: Climbing the long stair, Bree practises her message that the captain's whale fears thunder and is rocking the ship.

p_reveal_a2.event: In the officers' corridor Bree tells a mate she is not a passenger and ducks past to the wheelhouse door.

p_reveal_mid.event: Bree bursts into the wheelhouse and delivers her practised message to the captain.

e_set_reveal.event: Turned back by the flood, Bree arrives too late; the crew leveled the ship the hard way, and the captain wraps her in a blanket.

p_people1.event: Bree runs for help and must choose between the loud bosun and the captain who knows the hold's secret.

p_people_a.event: The bosun believes Bree because she told him the truth, and charges up to the captain with her.

p_people_cold.event: The bosun, who does not know Bree, disbelieves her whale story but carries her to the captain anyway.

p_people_b.event: Bree tells the captain she has seen Nimbus through the storm-opened door; the captain has her walk with her.

p_people_mid.event: Bree and Pip come through the wheelhouse doors into lamps, sliding charts and a straining helmsman.

n_bridge.event: The ship drops; the captain names Nimbus as the cause, shows the speaking tube, hears the envelope is tearing, and asks Bree where to stand.

b_steer1.event: The captain needs Nimbus still for ten minutes; thunder makes him boom down the tube as Pip stirs in Bree's coat.

b_steer_ok.event: Bree hums three falling notes down the tube; a familiar hoooom answers, Nimbus stills and the ship answers the helm.

b_steer_ok2.event: Bree hums through the worst of the storm until the Cirrus rises into calm moonlit air.

e_set_final.event: Bree's shout booms like thunder down the tube; Nimbus thrashes, the crew fight all night, and the captain puts her ashore.

e_win_save_ship.event: The captain thanks Bree for forty minutes of humming and names her one of the ship's own; Nimbus reaches the haven.

b_steer_purr.event: Bree holds sardine-full Pip to the tube; his purr rolls down to the hold and Nimbus stops booming and answers.

e_win_purr.event: Pip purrs for an hour, Nimbus sleeps, the Cirrus climbs clear; Pip is made ship's cat and Bree his keeper, aboard to stay.

b_patch1.event: Under the tearing envelope the rigger says only someone small can reach the tear and asks if Bree has crossed live rope; a winch waits below.

b_patch_ok.event: Bree tells the rigger she crossed the rope-bridge tonight; he recognises her, clips her on, and she threads the patch closed.

b_patch_alt.event: A ship's boy climbs to the tear while Bree cranks the winch until the patch-line closes the tear.

e_win_patch.event: The patch holds, Nimbus sleeps, and the captain signs Bree on as rigger's mate, with Pip signing the log too.

e_win_steer.event: The ship rights itself; the crew lift Bree high, the captain offers her a berth and thanks her for her sleeping cargo.

e_set_aloft.event: Never having crossed live rope, Bree freezes in the rigging; the rigger must fetch her and the Cirrus limps to an emergency mooring.

b_free1.event: Nimbus wants out; the storm has torn the cargo door open, he wears a harness nobody can reach, and a quiet inner bay is near.

b_free_ok.event: Bree says she freed his fin; the captain slips the harness and Nimbus opens both fins and rises into the storm.

b_free_ok2.event: Nimbus calms the wind, circles the ship, astonishes the bosun, and leads the Cirrus east through a gap in the clouds.

e_win_free.event: Nimbus leads the ship to the haven and joins his kind; the captain credits the freed fin and gives Bree a berth.

b_free_alt.event: Humming, Bree leads Nimbus into the padded inner bay, where he settles and the ship steadies.

e_win_friend.event: Bree sits with Nimbus through the night; at the haven the keepers praise her and she watches him join his own kind.

e_neu_kite.event: With one fin pinned, Nimbus is towed into port like a kite and must rest a week before the haven.

b_tell1.event: Bree says the crew should know; the captain warns hunters pay for sky-whales, and the crew wait on the ladder.

b_tell_crew.event: Bree tells the crew about the whale; the bosun vouches that she told him she was a stowaway, and everyone runs.

e_win_crew.event: The port watch hums Nimbus through the night; the crew make Bree a shipmate and the captain salutes her.

b_tell_doubt.event: The crew laugh at Bree's whale story; the bosun says he does not know her and nobody moves.

b_tell_captain.event: The captain tells the crew in four sentences and offers Bree a wet place at Nimbus's side or a warm bunk below.

e_win_captain.event: Bree and the captain hum by Nimbus all night; at dawn the captain writes Bree into the log as crew.

e_neu_home.event: Bree sleeps through the end of the storm; at port the captain invites her back when she is taller, with the cat.

b_tell_reveal.event: Bree drags the bosun and crew to the sealed hold; they see Nimbus, the bosun doffs his cap, and all begin to hum.

e_win_discovery.event: Forty voices hum Nimbus through the storm; the cook learns where the mash goes and the captain asks Bree to sail with them.

e_set_eng.gift: the ash bucket joke and a sad low note through the bench hint at a secret cargo; the catwalk was the patient way

e_set_hold.gift: a grey cat rescues Bree, and she leaves without his name; the tidy aisle was the safer way

e_set_nest.gift: the lookout's joke that the ship flies heavy as if with a whale aboard; the clip was within reach

e_set_salon.gift: a warm bun and the steward's hint that something odder is aboard; the trolley was the quiet hiding place

e_set_galley.gift: Pip unmasked as the sardine thief, kept as galley cat, and the riddle of forty buckets of mash

e_set_cabin.gift: a hidden whale sketch named NIMBUS and an officer's too-quick cloud excuse

e_set_rig.gift: the rigger's lesson that ropes do not like to be rushed, and a mutter about an old seam

e_set_storm1.gift: a sad note that rises with the thunder; the answer was under the near hatch

e_set_storm2.gift: the bosun also wonders what is in the sealed hold; holding on to the buckets was the way

e_set_reveal.gift: the captain's quiet thanks and the lesson that a slow messenger still arrives but a wet one sneezes

e_set_final.gift: a raised voice frightens Nimbus like thunder; soft and low was the way to reach him

e_win_save_ship.gift: Bree's humming steadies the whale and the ship, and she becomes one of the ship's own

e_win_purr.gift: the cat Bree fed saves the ship with a purr and earns them both a place aboard

e_win_patch.gift: Bree's rope-bridge practice lets her mend the envelope and sign on as rigger's mate

e_win_steer.gift: steady work on the winch saves the ship and earns Bree a berth and the captain's thanks

e_set_aloft.gift: nobody is born knowing ropes; the rope-bridge was there all night to teach her

e_win_free.gift: the freed fin lets Nimbus fly home to the haven and Bree earns a berth

e_win_friend.gift: Bree sits with Nimbus through the storm and sees him safely join his own kind

e_neu_kite.gift: a whale flown like a kite makes a harbor laugh, but one twisted strap delays his homecoming

e_win_crew.gift: honesty with the bosun makes the crew believe Bree, and she becomes their shipmate

e_win_captain.gift: the captain trusts her crew, sings with Bree, and writes her into the log as crew

e_neu_home.gift: a real storm survived, a sky-whale seen, and an invitation to come back taller

e_win_discovery.gift: the secret becomes a wonder the whole crew shares, and Bree is asked to sail with them
